import pyautogui, time
# Click the earliest of the latest 5 messages (HKU Daily Email Digest (25 JAN 2024)) at approx (380, 367)
pyautogui.click(380, 367)
time.sleep(0.3)
# Shift-click the most recent of the latest 5 messages (HKU Daily Email Digest (30 JAN 2024)) at approx (380, 551)
pyautogui.keyDown('shift')
pyautogui.click(380, 551)
pyautogui.keyUp('shift')
time.sleep(0.5)
traj.r:
Reflection:
- Thunderbird is now frontmost and the "daily" folder message list is visible. The task requires extracting the latest 5 messages (earliest → most recent). traj.a:
import pyautogui, time
# Save the open message source: press Ctrl+S
pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's')
time.sleep(0.5)
# Type the full path for the file on Desktop and press Enter
pyautogui.typewrite('/home/user/Desktop/hku_digest_25jan_source.txt', interval=0.02)
time.sleep(0.2)
pyautogui.press('enter')
time.sleep(0.5)
traj.r:
Reflection:
- The raw message source window is open. To keep the source for the first message, I should save it to the Desktop with the expected name hku_digest_25jan_source.txt. I'll use the Save shortcut (Ctrl+S), type the full path, and confirm.
